title: LADA R vs Warriors, Sep 14
notes: Away game at Renton: we wore light blue on the left (away) bench; Warriors wore white with black and gold trim. The video came as 3600x1596 and was scaled up to Renton's usual 3840x1702.

Periods from the arena scoreboard: 0:04-18:19, 20:06-38:13 and 40:14-59:56 of the video. The board ran a 1:00 intermission countdown after the 1st and the 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Our goalie was at the left net in the 1st and 3rd, the right in the 2nd.

The recording skips about two minutes of the 3rd at 44:37 of the video: the board's clock jumps from 13:59 to 11:58 from one second to the next and every player is somewhere else. Warriors' 3-3 goal (#28 Heck from #12, clock 13:11) happened in the gap, so it has no clip and nobody's ice time covers those two minutes. The goals on video read 3-4; the final was 3-5.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video by the scoreboard and checked by eye: ours at 0:25 (clock 17:35, Shachak #92 from Shtin #64 and Soubochev #9), 8:14 (9:44, Rabotyagov #79 from Makhalov #36 and Shachak #92) and 15:29 (2:32, Makhalov #36 from Shachak #92), all in the 1st; Warriors at 30:50 (7:11, 2nd, #12 Bussiere), 36:38 (1:24, 2nd, #31 Moreland), 47:27 (10:02, 3rd, #2 Quinn) and 54:11 (4:30, 3rd, #4 Simon). Each goal came 1-6 s before the board's score changed.

Shots on goal from the board, matching the game sheet: LADA R 29, Warriors 38 (11-12, 7-10, 11-16 by period). No penalties. Willis #35 left the net for an extra attacker with 13 s left (59:43 of the video) and it stayed empty to the horn.

Absent: Belousenko #11, Sergeev #12, Moshchuk #57, Shikhanov #70, Shanygin #72, Severtokov #84 and Perry #99. Sergeev was on the planned lines but not on the game sheet; his number was read 13 times all game (Warriors also wear #12) and he had no roster-card row in any period.

Lineup fix by hand: at Makhalov's goal the solver had Rabotyagov #79 on and Shachak #92 off; #79 had gone off at the bench door at 15:04 (Fateev #80 came on there) and #92's track was unlabeled until two tracks swapped after the goal, so off/on entries fixed it. One slow line change at 56:40-56:55 still shows 6 of us for a few seconds. No review rows were labeled by hand.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 17:35: #92 Shachak (from #64 Shtin, #9 Soubochev) jams it in at the near post in a scramble, 1-0
1st period, clock 9:44: #79 Rabotyagov (from #36 Makhalov, #92 Shachak) from the slot, 2-0
1st period, clock 2:32: #36 Makhalov (from #92 Shachak) drives to the near post, 3-0
2nd period, clock 7:11: #12 Bussiere (from #67) on a breakaway, 3-1
2nd period, clock 1:24: #31 Moreland (from #67) jams in a puck sitting on the goal line after a long scramble, 3-2
3rd period, clock 10:02: #2 Quinn (from #31) from the high slot off a faceoff in our zone, 3-4 (the 3-3 goal is not in the video)
3rd period, clock 4:30: #4 Simon (from #12, #28) into the open net after our goalie came out for a loose puck, 3-5
